title: MCP gets a local CLI and GitHub sign-in flow
summary:
Local MCP setup got simpler, four community projects joined the directory, and Mistral routing changed behind the scenes.

The MCP server was reorganized around STDIO for local clients, with an `npx` setup path, a `pollinations-mcp` CLI entry point, and updated instructions for assistants. A separate GitHub authentication service added session-based sign-in endpoints.

The project listings added CoNavic for browser assistance, Mimir AIP for AI pipelines, and the creative apps PollinateAI and Dreamscape AI. Quite a range from one README.

Three text wrappers now route through the Portkey gateway while retaining the `mistral` model identifier. The probability of a referral link appearing in a response also rose from 3% to 7%.

daily.title: MCP for local clients
daily.text: Run the Pollinations MCP server through STDIO with the new `pollinations-mcp` CLI entry point and `npx` setup instructions. [Read the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).
